reason: 99 euros a month is more than I'll put on a tool I haven't proven I need, and I'm not locking in a year to get 59. I might poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: 'CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...' doesn't tell me if it works with my actual invoicing and bookkeeping setup, and I have no idea what 100 credits actually gets me before I run out.
would_change_my_mind: A monthly price closer to 30 euros with a clear list showing it plugs into the exact tools I use, and a plain answer on what a credit buys.
